question: Which of these is NOT the correctly stated component of the expenditure method of measuring national income?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Export plus import expenditure.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The expenditure method of measuring national income involves adding up the final expenditures made by households, firms, governments, and foreigners.
 
• Final investment expenditure by firms and final government expenditure are correctly stated components of the expenditure method.
 
• Final consumption expenditure by households is also a correctly stated component of the expenditure method.
 
• Export plus import expenditure, is a component of the expenditure method, but is NOT correctly stated. This should have been export-import expenditure, which is known as net exports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Final investment expenditure by firms:-**

 
 
• It refers to the amount spent by businesses on capital goods, such as machinery and equipment, that are used to produce goods and services.
 
 
 
• **Final government expenditure:-**
 
 
• It includes all spending by the government on goods and services, such as salaries of public employees and infrastructure projects.
 
 
 
• **Final consumption expenditure by households:-**
 
 
• It is the total amount spent by individuals and families on goods and services for personal use, such as food, clothing, and housing.
 
 
 
• **Net exports:-**
 
 
• These are the difference between the value of exports (goods and services sold to foreign countries) and imports (goods and services purchased from foreign countries).
